about.title: About Artinex
about.lead: A clearer lens on artificial intelligence.
paragraphs: Artinex started as an independent AI blog. This redesigned edition brings explainers, model and company references, tool discovery and attributed headlines into one place.
Our editorial pages are educational starting points; our live headline feed links directly to the original publishers. We do not present aggregated headlines as our own reporting.
This project is independent and is not affiliated with the organizations profiled here.

editorial-policy.title: Editorial policy
paragraphs: Where feasible, link to primary research, original product documentation, and official announcements. Label summaries and interpretation as such, and distinguish editorial articles from externally sourced headlines.
The initial educational articles in this release are editorial examples. Review, verify, and assign a named human editor before presenting them as independently fact-checked reporting.

AI-generated or assisted prose requires human review before publication. Significant corrections should be dated and explained. Do not copy and republish entire third-party articles without permission.
Claims about model capabilities, prices and availability change rapidly; always check the linked official pages.

sources.title: Sources and methodology
paragraphs: The live wire aggregates titles, source names, links and timestamps from a curated, allowlisted set of RSS or Atom feeds. Clicking a headline opens the original publisher.

An available feed is not an endorsement or guarantee of accuracy. Articles shown in the news wire are external sources, not original Artinex reporting. Outages and publication delays can affect freshness.
Research paper listings may be preprints without peer review. Verify technical and medical claims before relying on them. RSS headlines are not automatically converted into original Artinex articles.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This starter site does not include advertising trackers or third-party analytics by default. Your browser stores only theme preferences and draft content you explicitly create in the local editorial studio.

If the newsletter is enabled, the email address you submit is sent to the configured mailing list provider (Resend). This functionality is disabled until the site owner configures it. Consult the provider's data-processing documentation before launch.
The contact form uses an external Formspree endpoint originally included in the project. Replace or validate ownership of that endpoint before publishing.
The hosting provider may process basic request logs. This template does not establish jurisdiction-specific legal compliance; consult appropriate counsel before launch.

terms.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: Material on Artinex is provided for general educational and informational use. It may be incomplete or become outdated.
Third-party resources are controlled by their respective publishers, which are responsible for their own content, terms and privacy practices.
Do not rely on this site alone for medical, legal, financial, safety-critical or production security decisions.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.lead: Read critically. Verify at the source.
paragraphs: Example content is for demonstration and editorial review. It must not be confused with a current, independently verified news report.
An external link does not constitute endorsement. Product descriptions and pricing change; refer to official documentation and terms.

contact.title: Contact
paragraphs: To contact the editor, configure your own verified contact endpoint in the project before launch. The original site used Formspree; the endpoint is documented in the project manual.
For corrections, include the article URL, the sentence in question and a supporting primary source.
